description_en: Queries the details of a specified server that is exposed on the Internet
description_zh: 查询指定服务器在互联网的暴露详情
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-exposed-instance-detail --uuid fc82b966-4d70-4e01-bf4f-aa4076a50000 --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --lang zh --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeExposedInstanceDetail

parameters.description_en:
The UUID of the server or the instance ID of the database that is exposed on the Internet.

>  You can call the [DescribeExposedInstanceList](~~DescribeExposedInstanceList~~) operation to query the UUIDs of servers or instance IDs of databases.
parameters.description_zh:
指定要查询的暴露在互联网的服务器类型资产的UUID或数据库类型资产的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeExposedInstanceList](~~DescribeExposedInstanceList~~)接口查询暴露在互联网的服务器UUID或数据库实例ID。
